violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Cooked meats in the cold hold were dated 8-7 on 8-26 and need to be discarded.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. -Plates in the Kitchen prep area were not stacked upside-down.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Multiple boxes of single-use items stored on the floor in dry storage room.
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Food display protection, condiment protection, clean tableware usage, sign posted (1 pt deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
